content:
anna-sales: FYI customer (FinTech POC) hitting intermittent 5xxs under load. Running our standard POC harness at ~300 concurrent requests for 10m. They see bursts of 502/504 and whole batch failures. Can we triage?

mike-se: Details from the run: model=redwood-v2-large, prompt avg ~120 tokens, top_p 0.95, stream=false. Using hosted endpoint in us-west1. Payloads look normal. Error snippet from client:
```
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
content-type: application/json
{x_request_id: "trace-8a3f9b2c"}
{error: "upstream read timeout"}
```

jess-eng-sre: Got it. Can you paste the x-request-id / trace id from their failing requests? Also which API key/account? Need to check router logs + backend pod logs.

mike-se: Trace IDs: trace-8a3f9b2c, trace-8a3f9b9f, trace-8a3f9c10. Customer account id cust-8812. Repro runs done at 2026-03-18T21:10Z.

deploy-bot: [deploy] redwood-runtime v3.4.7 deployed to us-west1 at 2026-03-18T20:45Z :rocket:

kai-eng-infra: Looking at autoscaler and node provisioning for cust-8812. Observed scaling latency ~70-110s for GPUs due to cloud GPU allocation + k8s node join. HPA target was CPU pct 60, but batch workload is token-bound so CPU not a good signal. Also account doesn't have Dedicated reserved capacity; they are on hosted scaling only. When concurrent spikes happen we hit request queueing then gateway timeouts.

jess-eng-sre: From router logs for trace-8a3f9b2c:
```
router: allocating request -> backend pool=rw-v2-large-usw
router: selected pod=rw-v2-large-2abc
router: forwarded, waiting on response
backend: pod rw-v2-large-2abc: OOM? killing process
kube: pod restart due to SIGKILL
router: upstream closed connection -> 502
```
This looks like backend pod instability under memory pressure + slow cold starts when new pods spin up.

sam-support: I can provision a temporary capacity bump on the customer's hosted quota (raise max concurrent pods) for the POC window. Would need approval from sales leadership.

anna-sales: Please do, customer is in evaluation and blocks this week if we don't show stable throughput.

kai-eng-infra: Short term mitigations we can do immediately:
- reduce max concurrent requests per connection (throttle client)
- enable queued request buffer on router (drop-after-queue-limit)
- add a lightweight fallback model (rw-v2-medium-q4) to handle overflow with lower cost & faster cold start
- tune HPA to use queue length / custom metric (inference-requests-per-pod) instead of CPU

jess-eng-sre: Also recommending to patch runtime to avoid large prefetch memory spikes (we saw memory usage spikes from KV cache when sequence length > 1024). Patch scheduled to roll in 1 hour; I'll open a hotfix PR.

mike-se: Customer asked about pricing if we serve on fallback model for some percent of requests during POC. Can we give an estimate?

sam-support: For the POC we can offer a temporary 50% discount on overflow tokens served by fallback model until EOM. I'll document details in the POC SOW.

anna-sales: Thanks. For test plan can we ask the customer to throttle their harness to 180 concurrent and re-run while we apply mitigations?

mike-se: Will request that. Also attaching a curl example with headers for future triage:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-cust-..." \n  -H "X-Request-ID: trace-8a3f9b2c" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-v2-large","input":"...","max_tokens":150}'
```

kai-eng-infra: Action items assigned:
- kai: bump hosted concurrency ceiling for cust-8812 to 2x for 6h (temp) -> in progress
- jess: deploy memory-spike hotfix to runtime canary -> in 45m
- infra: add fallback route config to customer account (rw-v2-medium-q4) -> in progress
- support: apply POC billing override -> sam doing approvals

jess-eng-sre: Quick note — we also saw some pod OOMs from python worker processes due to tokenization peaks. Short term we can limit per-request token cap from 200->150 for the POC runs. Communicated to customer.

mike-se: Customer re-ran at 180 concurrent, still seeing occasional ~3% 502s but throughput much more stable. They reported average latency 220ms tokenwise vs 150ms baseline.

jess-eng-sre: After hotfix rolled to canary the canary pods stayed healthy. No OOMs. Still seeing cold-starts ~65s for GPU nodes. We should document cold-start behavior in docs and recommend pre-warming or reserved for production.

sam-support: Temporary quota bump applied. Billing override approved by finance for POC.

anna-sales: Great. Customer will extend POC by 3 days to finish final perf tests. Please follow up with a short runbook of recommended configs (max concurrency, token cap, fallback model) and an RCA after the POC ends.

kai-eng-infra: Will add runbook to the account notes and create a follow-up ticket to propose autoscale metric changes.

jess-eng-sre: Will prepare RCA draft post-POC with memory traces and mitigations.

mike-se: Thanks all — keeping customer looped in. I'll post final test logs in this thread when they finish the extended run. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: [canary] runtime hotfix v3.4.8-canary deployed to us-west1

anna-sales: Closing here for now, moving to follow-up thread for RCA.
